name: Lightning Burst
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a copper ring)

EFFECT

Range personal
Area 50-ft. disc-burst that is 5-ft. wide along one plane (horizontal, vertical, or anywhere in between)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You burst out with a sheet of lightning dealing 1d6 electricity damage per caster level (maximum 15d6) to all creatures in the burst. You are not affected by this spell and a Reflex save halves the damage.
